route_has_problem.description: Tests if a route has a delay, detour, closure or slow zone. Old or missing information does not pass.

route.description: The route number, for example 504, or 1 for Line 1.
route.name: Route

route_has_problem.name: Route has a problem

station_is_step_free.description: Tests if no elevator is reported out of service at a station. Old or missing information does not pass.

station.description: The station name, as the TTC writes it, for example St George.
station.name: Station

station_is_step_free.name: Station is step-free

error.cannot_connect: The TTC did not answer. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_stop: One of the stop numbers is not known to the TTC. Stop numbers are printed on the stop sign.
error.no_stations: Choose at least one station, or turn off elevators and escalators in the first step.
error.no_stops: Choose at least one stop, or turn off next departures in the first step.
error.nothing_chosen: Choose at least one thing to watch.
error.routes_unavailable: The list of bus and streetcar routes could not be read, so only the subway lines are offered. You can try again later.

data_description.routes: Subway lines, buses and streetcars to show the status of. Search by number or name.
data_description.stations: Stations to watch for elevators and escalators out of service. You can type a station that is not listed.

routes.description: Choose routes and stations. Only these numbers are asked for.
routes.title: Routes and stations

data_description.stops: Stops on your routes, or type the stop number from the stop sign.

stops.description: Choose stops for next departures. Each is checked every 45 seconds.
stops.title: Stops for next departures

data_description.watch_alerts: Delays, detours and closures, read once a minute.
data_description.watch_departures: Predicted departures at stops you choose.
data_description.watch_lifts: Out of service at stations you choose, read every few minutes.

user.description: Choose what to watch. This reads the TTC's public information and sends nothing about your home. You can change this later.
user.title: TTC transit

invalid_stop.message: Stop {stop} is not known to the TTC.

malformed.message: The TTC answered with information that could not be read: {error}

not_loaded.message: TTC transit is not set up or not loaded.

refused.message: The TTC refused the request (status {status}). It will be asked again later.

unreachable.message: The TTC could not be reached: {error}

route.description: Only departures of this route number.

get_departures.name: Get departures

refresh.description: Reads the TTC's information again now.
refresh.name: Refresh

minutes.description: How many minutes before the departure.
minutes.name: Within

route.description: Only departures of this route number. Leave empty for any route at the stop.

stop.description: A stop number chosen in the setup.
stop.name: Stop

departure_within.name: Next departure is within

station.name: Station

lift_changed.name: Elevator or escalator goes out or comes back

new_alert.description: Triggers once for each new alert posted across the network.
new_alert.name: New alert is posted

time_to_leave.name: Time to leave
